mapper.select: SELECT sc.id id, sc.studentId studentId, sc.courseId courseId, sc.teacherId teacherId, s.username studentName, c.courseName courseName, c.credits courseCredits, c.academicYear academicYear, sc.isQualified isQualified, sc.creditsRemark creditsRemark, sc.state state, c.teachEndDate teachEndDate, s.studentNumber studentNumber FROM student_course_rel sc LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=sc.courseId LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = sc.studentId WHERE c.teacherId=#{teacherId} AND c.academicYear = #{academicYear} AND s.username LIKE '%' || #{studentName} || '%' AND c.courseName LIKE '%' || #{courseName} || '%' ORDER BY c.courseName, s.studentNumber
mapper.update: UPDATE student_course_rel sc SET state=#{record.state}, isQualified=#{record.isQualified}, teacherId=#{teacherId}, creditsRemark=#{record.creditsRemark} FROM course c WHERE sc.courseId = c.id AND sc.id=#{record.id} AND c.teacherId=#{teacherId} AND c.teachEndDate <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND sc.state='0'

UPDATE student_course_rel sc SET state='0', isQualified='0', teacherId=#{teacherId}, creditsRemark=' ' FROM course c WHERE sc.courseId = c.id AND sc.id=#{id} AND c.teacherId=#{teacherId} AND sc.state='1'
mapper.select: SELECT count(s.studentNumber) as "count", cu.name name FROM student_course_rel sc LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id=sc.courseId LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = sc.studentId LEFT JOIN college cu ON cu.id = c.collegeId WHERE c.teacherId=#{teacherId} GROUP BY name

SELECT co.name AS "collegeName", COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS "totalStudents", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id ELSE NULL END) AS "selectedStudents", COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id ELSE NULL END) AS "unselectedStudents", ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM course c2 WHERE c2.collegeId = #{collegeId} AND c2.academicYear = #{academicYear} AND c2.state = '1' ) AS "collegeCourseCount", COUNT(c.id) AS "selectionCount", COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(COUNT(c.id) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 0), 2), 0) AS "avgCoursePerStudent" FROM college co LEFT JOIN student s ON s.collegeId = co.id AND s.state = '1' LEFT JOIN student_course_rel sc ON sc.studentId = s.id LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = sc.courseId AND c.academicYear = #{academicYear} AND c.state = '1' WHERE co.id = #{collegeId} GROUP BY co.id, co.name

SELECT c.courseName AS "courseName", c.optional AS "optional", COUNT(sc.id) AS "selectedCount" FROM course c LEFT JOIN student_course_rel sc ON sc.courseId = c.id WHERE c.teacherId = #{teacherId} AND c.academicYear = #{academicYear} AND c.state = '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.courseName, c.optional ORDER BY c.courseName

SELECT c.courseName AS "courseName", c.optional AS "optional", COUNT(sc.id) AS "selectedCount" FROM course c LEFT JOIN student_course_rel sc ON sc.courseId = c.id WHERE c.collegeId = #{collegeId} AND c.academicYear = #{academicYear} AND c.state = '1' GROUP BY c.id, c.courseName, c.optional ORDER BY COUNT(sc.id) DESC, c.courseName LIMIT 10
SELECT t.id, t.loginName, t.username, t.phone, t.email, t.collegeId, t.createDate, t.roleId, c.name collegeName FROM teacher t LEFT JOIN college c ON t.collegeId = c.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher SET phone = #{phone}, email = #{email} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, loginName, username FROM teacher WHERE loginName = #{loginName} AND password = #{password} AND state = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher SET password = #{newPassword} WHERE id = #{id}
